question: In June 2022, the 4th Edition of the Khelo India Youth Games was inaugurated in the state of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **Haryana**__.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fourth iteration of the **Khelo India Youth Games **will take place in 2022. 
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games** 2021**, which had been **delayed** three times **because of COVID-19**, **was conducted** from J**une 4–13, 2022**, in various locations.
 
• The **fourth** Khelo India Youth** Games** will take place** in Haryana**. The Khelo India Youth Games are slated for 2021,** following the Tokyo Olympics**. The** venue **for the Games will be **Panchkula, Haryana**.
 
• **Kiren Rijiju**, the minister of sports, and **Manohar Lal Khattar**, the chief minister of Haryana, made the **announcement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Games**

 
 
• **​**Under-17-year-old school kids and under-21-year-old college students compete in the **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG),** formerly known as the **Khelo India School Games, **which are held annually in** January or February **at the national level in India. To help them get ready for the international sporting events, the top **1,000 children** would each receive an annual scholarship **worth 5 lacks (US$6,300) for eight years.**
 
• In its initial phase, the** Training of Trainers (TOT) Program** ran from December 2018 to January 2019.
 
• Throughout the months of December and January, a total of 160 trainers will receive training in 4 batches of 40 each. All interested teachers, principals, vice-principals, and physical education instructors will be included in this **TOT Program**, which will be conducted every two or four months.
